verdict.rationale: Galileo's docs show prompt templates can be set up through its MCP server (galileo-docs-4), and its experiments can evaluate prompts (galileo-docs-2), so some prompt-management capability exists. Nothing in the evidence shows prompt versioning or pushing prompt changes to production without a code deploy. Missing for 10: prompt version history/registry, deploying or promoting prompt versions to production without shipping code, SDK runtime fetch of managed prompts, independent corroboration.
